bio: Set in the heart of the Suffolk countryside, with the historic market town of Bury St Edmunds on the doorstep, Ravenwood Hall Hotel is the perfect place to stay, dine or celebrate in style.  With its origins dating back to the reign of Henry VIII; Ravenwood Hall is crammed full of character and architectural features such as ornate carved oak structure, inglenook fireplaces and rare 15th century wall paintings.  Begin your culinary voyage with their savory delights, meticulously prepared to excite your palate. Delight in delicate finger sandwiches filled with a symphony of flavors, experience the perfect balance of textures and tastes with their selection of exquisite savouries, surrender to temptation with our exquisite assortment of sweet treats.  Indulge in freshly baked scones, served warm with clotted cream and homemade Jam, sample their signature cakes, each a masterpiece of craftsmanship and taste, lovingly created to enchant and delight.
